scientific_integrity: Analytical proof of all-lattice local singularity classification; numerical tests are supplementary. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact uniform-pair intrinsic distance laws on full-rank Euclidean flat two-tori only; unoriented geometry. No finite-sample stability or higher-dimensional assertion. Global isometry recoverability is previously known in Proposition 5.16 of arXiv:1810.09646v3; the local universal coefficient and no-spurious-threshold classification is the assessed claim. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Exact square-root singularities enumerate the Voronoi facets of every flat two-torus
